title: SentinelCI Tool status v1
description: What happened to every security tool of a scan, produced by the pipeline (A3) and read by `sentinel evaluate` (B4). Any status other than `ok` makes the gate block with SC-010 inside a recorded decision (SPEC section 6.3). A superset of the `sentinel tools verify --report` manifest: same field names, plus `status` and `detail` per tool.

lock_sha256.description: sha256 of the tools.lock.toml the tools were verified against (the base commit's, ADR-0008).

tools.description: Every tool the scan was supposed to run. An empty map would vouch for nothing, so it is invalid.

status.description: ok: verified against the lock and ran to completion. failed: crashed or exited with an unexpected code. timeout: killed after its time limit. integrity_mismatch: the binary did not match the lock (never run). not_run: expected but not started.

detail.description: Why the tool is not ok; shown in the PR comment.
